display.purpose: The promise on the landing cover sheet; condensed to wdth 78%, balanced, max 14ch.

headline.purpose: The preset name on the title card; width axis fitted per name to set on one line.

nameplate.purpose: The Stims wordmark, printed like a maker's name at wdth 75%.

body-lead.purpose: The cover tagline and single lead paragraphs, max 30rem.

button.purpose: Every tab and button label, bold at wdth 88%.

legend.purpose: Graph band names, the Driven by row header and spec lines; uppercase at wdth 78%.

catalog-number.purpose: Preset catalog digits, bold at wdth 75% in tabular figures, after a spec-grey No. prefix.

code.purpose: Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono for preset code and engine readouts.

shadows.name: on-stage-strip
shadows.purpose: Every punched .stims-stock card on the stage; filter, because the rivet mask clips box-shadow.

shadows.name: shadow-strong
shadows.purpose: Sheets and dialogs over the stage.

motion.name: transition-fast
motion.purpose: Border and colour changes on hover.

motion.name: motion-enter
motion.purpose: The strip pull: translateY up 4-6px on hover or focus.

motion.name: title-card-swing
motion.value: 0.48s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), rotate(-3deg) to 0 about the rivet
motion.purpose: Title card arriving on a preset change; leaves with 0.32s cubic-bezier(0.7, 0, 0.84, 0). Fade only under reduced motion.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: All transition tokens collapse under prefers-reduced-motion.

focus.purpose: Amber in both themes (#ffb21a dark, #8a4e00 light).

rivet.mask: radial-gradient(circle at var(--rivet-x) var(--rivet-y), transparent var(--rivet-r), #000 calc(var(--rivet-r) + 0.5px))
rivet.eyelet: 1px solid var(--stims-line), circle of radius rivet-r + 1px

narrative.overview:
Every preset is a numbered lighting-gel filter on a strip of matte black card, riveted at one end, and the stage is the light it colours. The chrome is the swatchbook held up in front of that light: opaque card, printed in one off-white and one spec grey, die-cut at small corners, with a hole punched through each strip that shows whatever is playing behind it. Nothing in the chrome emits light except one safelight amber, and amber means one thing: this is lit.

The stage is always the brightest thing on screen and stays dark in every theme. Chrome that sits on it is a card, not a frosted pill: the landing's cover sheet, the starter strips under it, the title card that swings in on a preset change, and the dock strip along the bottom. Off the stage (editor, settings, Browse page, Read pages) the same stock becomes the page; the light theme is the swatchbook's inner pages, white card printed in near-black with the amber darkened to ink.

Density is a printed spec sheet's: numbers, names and legends in a condensed technical grotesque, running text at full width, code in a mono drawn for low-vision readers, tabular figures wherever a number appears. The owner has rejected multi-hue gradients, glassmorphism and springy, overshooting motion; the system carries all three as hard prohibitions.
keyCharacteristics: Matte black card stock for every chrome surface; the stage keeps the colour.
Safelight amber as the only emitted colour, reserved for lit state.
One white page tab per view for the primary action (black in the light theme).
A punched rivet hole with a 1px eyelet on every strip that prints a preset.
One typeface at several widths: Pathway Extreme from 75% to 100% wdth.
One 1px rule weight for every rule, outline and eyelet.
Corners die-cut on a short guarded ladder (6px strips, 4px controls).
Motion is a pull and a swing: strips slide up out of the book, the title card rotates into place about its rivet.

rules.name: The Safelight Rule
rules.body: Amber is spent only on lit state: bands a preset reads, on or selected controls, focus, live dots. Never on hints, warnings, decorative rules, badges or prose. If an amber element is not reporting that something is on, lit or focused, it is the wrong colour.

rules.name: The Stage Pins Its Own Ink Rule
rules.body: Anything that sits on the stage pins the on-stage tokens for fill, ink, accent and lines (--stims-on-stage-*, or by overriding --stock-fill, --stims-accent, --stims-line, --stims-ink on the element). The stage is dark in the light theme, and a surface that follows the page palette there draws a light card under white ink. A surface and the ink on it come from the same palette.

rules.name: The Neutral Field Rule
rules.body: Gradients are single-hue neutrals or functional masks (the stage floor's lift, the ruled grid, the rivet punch). Never a gradient of three or more hues; the only colour on a page is the preset's.

rules.name: The Width Axis Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy comes from width and weight within one family, not from a second display face. Condense to fit a name; never shrink a name below the scale to fit it.

rules.name: The Tabular Truth Rule
rules.body: Every number the chrome prints (catalog numbers, readouts, BPM, counts) sets in tabular figures.

rules.name: The Scale Floor Rule
rules.body: Sizes come from the --text-* ladder (0.6875rem floor) and weights from 400/500/600/700/760/820; bun run check:css-scale fails on anything else.

rules.name: The Shadow Through the Hole Rule
rules.body: A mask clips box-shadow, and the rivet hole is a mask. A punched strip takes its shadow from filter: drop-shadow on the element, which is drawn after the hole is cut.

rules.name: The Opaque Card Rule
rules.body: Chrome is opaque card. Glass (backdrop-filter) is allowed only on a small control floating directly on the stage, and low and mid device tiers strip it.

rules.name: The One Line Weight Rule
rules.body: Every rule, outline, eyelet, divider and graph baseline is 1px. Emphasis comes from colour (rule line to rule line strong to amber), never from a heavier stroke. Focus outlines (2px) are the only exception.

dos: Do spend amber only on lit state: read bands, on/selected controls, focus, live dots.
Do give each view exactly one white page tab (black in the light theme) for its primary action; everything else is an outline or ghost tab.
Do pin on-stage fill, ink, accent and line tokens on anything that sits on the stage and uses .stims-stock.
Do shadow punched strips with filter: drop-shadow, not box-shadow.
Do draw every rule, outline and eyelet at 1px.
Do take radii from the ladder (6px strips, 4px controls, 2px windows); bun run check:css-scale enforces it.
Do set every number in tabular figures and condense a long name with the width axis before wrapping it.
Do move strips with a pull (translateY up 4-6px) and settle with an exponential ease-out; give every motion a reduced-motion fade or nothing.
Do carry the lit/unlit meaning in words or accessible names as well as colour.
donts: Don't use amber for hints, warnings, decorative rules, badges or prose.
Don't put two white page tabs in one view.
Don't use a gradient of three or more hues anywhere in the chrome.
Don't use glass (backdrop-filter) except on a small control floating directly on the stage.
Don't use overshoot or spring easing (any cubic-bezier control value above 1 or below 0), and don't use View Transitions.
Don't throw coloured glows or halos; shadows are neutral black.
Don't let a light-theme surface sit on the stage; the stage is dark in every theme.
Don't introduce a second display family or a radius, size or weight off the scale.
